第3章 好一朵狠毒的白莲花（第1页）
看著恢宏的大殿上，满脸错愕的几个姐姐，暗中看好戏的叶轩，还有一脸愤怒的父亲
哦，不！是高高在上的叶家家主叶鼎。
挺直了胸膛，感受到前所未有的轻鬆与自在。
“楚尘哥哥，你快给父亲道歉！不要再惹父亲和姐姐们生气了。”
叶轩那软糯而又关切的声音迴荡在大殿之中，打断了叶楚尘的思绪，也打破了大殿之上的沉默与寂静。
当叶楚尘说要叛出叶家，断绝父子关係时，叶鼎和几个姐姐著实嚇了一跳。
他们虽然討厌叶楚尘，虽然看不上这个废物，虽然视他为累赘。
可叶楚尘毕竟是叶鼎的亲儿子，是叶寒、叶清清她们的亲弟弟，是叶灵儿的亲哥哥啊。
他们只想让叶楚尘把叶家圣子的位置让给叶轩，这么点小事，不是很简单吗？
为什么非要以断绝父子关係为由，闹得大家都不愉快。
他们没想著把叶楚尘赶出叶家，毕竟如今的叶楚尘不再是荒古大陆最耀眼的天之骄子，他只是个修为尽失的废物。
没了叶寒、叶清清等几个姐姐的关心。
他叶楚尘怕是前脚刚走出叶家，后脚就死在深山大泽之中。
难道叶楚尘不知道修行界的人心险恶？不知道深山大泽中妖兽横行？
可知道的话，他为什么还敢说出逐出家门、断绝父子关係这种话来？？
叶清清、叶寒和叶灵等人，同样费解。
往日摇尾乞怜，阿諛奉承，用脚踹都踹不走的舔狗叶楚尘，今日怎会这般
他的依仗到底是什么？难道是修为恢復了？
“楚尘哥哥，你不要衝动！不要说这种气话！”
眼看叶鼎面露难色，叶寒、叶清清等人又被叶楚尘一番话给彻底镇住，唯恐圣子之位与自己失之交臂，这个只有十岁的叶轩，再一次展现白莲、绿茶男的心机。
只见叶轩走到叶楚尘面前，两只肉嘟嘟的小手紧拽著叶楚尘的衣角，满脸担忧和关切的开口：
“楚尘哥哥，虽然你经常偷姐姐们的法宝，几天前还把父亲喜欢的丹炉打碎但这些都是小事，父亲和姐姐们不会真的生你的气。”
“只要你跟父亲和姐姐们认个错，跪在地上乞求他们原谅，他们是一定”
“我们都是一家人，有什么话好好说不行吗？为什么要威胁父亲和姐姐们呢？”
“父亲是叶家家主，真正的圣级强者，他不会因为你威胁他就让步的。”
此话一出，原本已经冷静下来的叶鼎和几个姐姐们，心里头突然窜出几道无名之火，蹭蹭蹭地往上冒。
怪不得敢说出要离开叶家，要跟自己断绝父子关係这种话。

Chapter 3 What a vicious white lotus (page 1)
Looking at the magnificent hall, several sisters with astonished faces, Ye Xuan who was secretly watching the show, and an angry father
Oh no! It was Ye Ding, the high-ranking head of the Ye family.
He straightened his chest and felt relaxed and at ease like never before.
"Brother Chu Chen, please apologize to your father! Don't make your father and sisters angry again."
Ye Xuan's soft and concerned voice echoed in the hall, interrupting Ye Chuchen's thoughts and breaking the silence above the hall.
When Ye Chuchen said that he would betray the Ye family and sever the relationship between father and son, Ye Ding and his sisters were really shocked.
Although they hate Ye Chuchen, although they despise this waste, although they regard him as a burden.
But after all, Ye Chuchen is Ye Ding's biological son, Ye Han and Ye Qingqing's biological brother, and Ye Ling'er's biological brother.
They just want Ye Chuchen to give up the position of the Ye Family's Holy Son to Ye Xuan. Isn't it simple for such a small thing?
Why do we have to use the excuse of severing the relationship between father and son to make everyone unhappy?
They didn't think of driving Ye Chuchen out of the Ye family. After all, Ye Chuchen was no longer the most dazzling and proud man of heaven in the ancient continent. He was just a waste who had lost all his cultivation.
Without the care of Ye Han, Ye Qingqing and other sisters.
He, Ye Chuchen, was afraid that he would die in the deep mountains and swamps as soon as he walked out of Ye's house.
Doesn't Ye Chuchen know that people in the spiritual world have sinister hearts? Don’t you know that monsters and beasts are rampant in the mountains and swamps?
But if he knew, why would he dare to say things like expulsion from the house and severing the relationship between father and son? ?
Ye Qingqing, Ye Han, Ye Ling and others were equally puzzled.
In the past, Ye Chuchen was a licking dog who could not be kicked away, but how could he be like this today?
What does he rely on? Could it be that his cultivation level has recovered?
"Brother Chu Chen, don't be impulsive! Don't say such angry words!"
Seeing Ye Ding's expression of embarrassment, Ye Han, Ye Qingqing and others were completely silenced by Ye Chuchen's words. They were afraid that they would miss the position of the Holy Son. Ye Xuan, who was only ten years old, once again showed the scheming of White Lotus and Green Tea Man.
I saw Ye Xuan walking up to Ye Chuchen, holding the corners of Ye Chuchen's clothes tightly with his two chubby little hands, and said with worry and concern on his face:
"Brother Chu Chen, although you often steal magic weapons from your sisters, and a few days ago you broke my father's favorite alchemy furnace, but these are small things, and my father and sisters will not really be angry with you."
"As long as you admit your mistake to your father and sisters, kneel on the ground and beg for their forgiveness, they will definitely do it."
"We are all a family. Can't we just talk to each other if we have anything to say? Why threaten my father and sisters?"
"My father is the head of the Ye family, a true saint-level powerhouse. He will not give in just because you threaten him."
As soon as these words came out, Ye Ding and his sisters, who had already calmed down, suddenly burst into unknown fires in their hearts, rising slowly.
No wonder he dared to say that he wanted to leave the Ye family and sever the father-son relationship with himself.
